home.title: Free Retirement Calculator: Will Your Savings Last? | RetCalc
home.desc: Free retirement calculator: see what your savings grow to by retirement in today's dollars, then test withdrawals, taxes, Roth conversions, healthcare and FIRE. Nothing leaves your browser.

advanced.title: Advanced Retirement Calculator: Taxes, Fees & Market History | RetCalc
advanced.desc: Project retirement savings with contribution growth, fees, account types, employer match and 2026 taxes, then run the plan through every market since 1926 or 5,000 random ones.

stages.title: Multi-Stage Retirement Savings Calculator | RetCalc
stages.desc: Plan retirement savings in stages, each with its own contribution, raises, return and investment mix, chained into one projection and tested against real market history.

guide.title: Retirement Readiness Check: Are You on Track? | RetCalc
guide.desc: A guided retirement check-up, one question at a time: a readiness score out of 100, your plan tested against every market since 1926, and the changes that would put you on track.

tools.title: Free Financial Planning Calculators | RetCalc
tools.desc: Free calculators for retirement withdrawals, a plan optimizer for Social Security and Roth conversions, early retirement, RMDs, healthcare, FIRE, taxes, mortgages, rent vs. buy, college, budgets and debt.

about.title: About RetCalc: How the Calculators Work
about.desc: How RetCalc's calculators work, where the tax rules and historical market data come from, and what each tool assumes.

drawdown.title: Retirement Withdrawal Calculator: Will My Money Last? | RetCalc
drawdown.desc: How much can you safely spend in retirement? Test the 4% rule and five flexible withdrawal strategies against every retirement since 1926, with Social Security and pensions.

4-percent-rule.title: 4% Rule Calculator: Does the Safe Withdrawal Rate Still Work? | RetCalc
4-percent-rule.desc: Test the 4% rule against every retirement since 1926: how often 4% lasted 30, 40 and 50 years, the years it failed and why, and the safe rate for your own mix and spending.

guardrails.title: Guyton-Klinger Guardrails Calculator: Spend More, Cut When Needed | RetCalc
guardrails.desc: Test Guyton-Klinger guardrails against every retirement since 1926: how much more you can start spending, how often and how deep the cuts came, and the leanest year in the worst start.

vpw.title: VPW Calculator: Variable Percentage Withdrawal Tested Since 1926 | RetCalc
vpw.desc: The Bogleheads' variable percentage withdrawal (VPW), tested against every retirement since 1926: each year's payment, how it rises with age, and how low it fell in the worst starts.

vanguard-dynamic-spending.title: Vanguard Dynamic Spending Calculator: Ceiling and Floor Rule Tested | RetCalc
vanguard-dynamic-spending.desc: Test Vanguard's dynamic spending rule, a share of the portfolio with spending rising at most 5% and falling at most 2.5% a year, against every retirement since 1926.

risk-based-guardrails.title: Risk-Based Guardrails Calculator: Spending Set by the Odds of Success | RetCalc
risk-based-guardrails.desc: Risk-based guardrails adjust spending only when the chance your plan lasts leaves a band. Test them against every retirement since 1926 and see how often, and how far, spending moved.

rmd-withdrawal-strategy.title: RMD Withdrawal Strategy: Spending by the IRS Life Expectancy Table | RetCalc
rmd-withdrawal-strategy.desc: Use required minimum distribution math as a spending rule: each year the balance divided by the IRS life-expectancy divisor. Tested against every retirement since 1926.

ratcheting-withdrawal.title: Kitces Ratchet Calculator: The 4% Rule With Raises | RetCalc
ratcheting-withdrawal.desc: The Kitces ratchet: start at 4% and raise spending 10% whenever the portfolio grows 50% above where it began. See how often retirees since 1926 got raises, and what it cost.

cape-withdrawal.title: CAPE-Based Withdrawal Rate Calculator: Spend by Market Valuation | RetCalc
cape-withdrawal.desc: Set your withdrawal rate from the stock market's CAPE ratio: more when stocks are cheap, less when they're dear. See today's rate at a CAPE of 41 and how it did since 1926.

optimizer.title: Retirement Plan Optimizer: Social Security, Withdrawals & Roth Conversions | RetCalc
optimizer.desc: When should each of you claim Social Security, which account should you draw first, and how much should you convert to Roth? It tests thousands of plans in every market since 1926, with 2026 taxes, and finds your best.

bridge.title: Early Retirement Calculator: Reach 59½ Penalty-Free | RetCalc
bridge.desc: Retiring before 59½? Compare a Roth conversion ladder, 72(t) payments, the rule of 55 and your brokerage, with 2026 taxes, penalties and ACA premiums, tested since 1926.

72t.title: 72(t) Calculator: SEPP Payments Before 59½ | RetCalc
72t.desc: Size 72(t) substantially equal periodic payments from an IRA before 59½ without the 10% penalty, and see if they carry you there in every market since 1926.

roth.title: Roth Conversion Calculator: Should You Convert? | RetCalc
roth.desc: Test Roth conversion strategies year by year to age 100 with 2026 federal and state taxes, Social Security, RMDs and Medicare IRMAA. See lifetime tax and after-tax wealth.

rmd.title: RMD Calculator: Required Minimum Distributions by Age | RetCalc
rmd.desc: Project your required minimum distributions every year to age 100 with the IRS Uniform Lifetime Table, and test whether Roth conversions before RMDs would lower your lifetime tax.

healthcare.title: Retirement Healthcare Cost Calculator: ACA & Medicare | RetCalc
healthcare.desc: Estimate retirement health costs: 2026 ACA marketplace premiums and subsidies before 65, then Medicare Part B, Part D, Medigap and IRMAA surcharges by income.

fire.title: FIRE Calculator & Coast FIRE Calculator | RetCalc
fire.desc: Find your FIRE number and the age you could reach financial independence, or when you could stop saving with Coast FIRE, with steady returns or every market since 1926.

backtest.title: Portfolio Backtest: Stock & Bond Returns Since 1926 | RetCalc
backtest.desc: See what any stock and bond mix actually returned since 1926: average and real return, volatility, worst year, deepest fall and every rolling 1 to 30-year period.

incometax.title: 2026 Income Tax Calculator: Federal, State & FICA | RetCalc
incometax.desc: Estimate 2026 take-home pay with federal brackets, all 50 states and FICA, or the tax on retirement income from IRAs, Roth, brokerage, pensions and Social Security.

mortgage.title: Mortgage Calculator with Taxes, PMI & Extra Payments | RetCalc
mortgage.desc: Calculate your full monthly mortgage payment with property tax, insurance, PMI and HOA, see amortization year by year, and test extra payments, recasting and refinancing.

rentbuy.title: Rent vs. Buy Calculator | RetCalc
rentbuy.desc: Should you rent or buy? Compare buyer and renter net worth year by year, counting the invested down payment, all costs of owning, appreciation, selling costs and taxes.

college.title: College Savings Calculator: How Much to Save Monthly | RetCalc
college.desc: How much to save each month for college, from public in-state to private and elite schools, with tuition inflation, current savings and 529 growth.

budget.title: Budget Calculator: Income, Spending & Savings | RetCalc
budget.desc: Build a monthly budget from your take-home pay, see what's left for saving and debt, and size your emergency fund. Export it as a spreadsheet.

debt.title: Debt Payoff Calculator: Avalanche vs. Snowball | RetCalc
debt.desc: List your debts and see your debt-free date, total interest and what you save over minimum payments, with the avalanche and snowball methods compared month by month.
